facts.fact: Decree 2022-092/PR/MCT of 4 May 2022 organises the ADN, a public industrial and commercial body under the Ministry of Commerce and Tourism, and calls it the national reference body for drawing up standards, charged with preparing and approving standards, certification of conformity and accreditation of conformity-assessment bodies; no IT or data standard is named.
facts.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

systems.system: Agence Djiboutienne des Normes et de la Qualité (ADN)

note: No certification fact: the decree gives the ADN a certification mandate but names no certification against an IT or data standard and no certified organisation.
